target_text:
Some people feel inspired to the quote " unless you do something beyond of you have mastered, you will never grow" written by Author Ralph Waldo Emerson. Meaning of what hes saying if you never stop learning about what you mastered already you'll grow, but some people disagree to that because they feel like they know too much already so what is the point of learn more? I say its because to achieve an new goal, to be a bigger person, and discover the unknown.

Everyday we want to achieve a new goal so we can grow as a whole. Scientist for an example, they discover more diseases and bacteria than we could ever know, they even found cures to the deadliest diseases like Chickenpox, and some cancers. one I thing i achieve everyday is making sure I stay on track in cosemetogly and making sure I know everything there is to know and then i learn more than what should i know.

Some people want to be big in life as in well known for what they did, for example some people got the noble prize because they discovered something new and it helped the world. in Africa I suffered from malaria and the medicine wasnt as good there but after I got better i came to America and got sick again but the medicine I took was really good and fast so i was be able to go to school and stuff and continue with life.

People want discover the unknown, right now technogly has advance so much were be able to do that. we discovered AI "robots like looks like humans" new spices, new diseases, new cures, etc. that we found everyday as we grow. Even the people who arent studying to be anything they discover new things everyday.

i think people who disagree with

Emerson's quote is wrong because we all grow as a human we never stop growing to be honest. and one example is

doctors they think they know everything as far as they know but scientist discover new diseases and doctor might not know them, so patients are diagnose with not so deadly disease and did not get the right treatment for it and further more come back and diagnosed with a deadly disease that is not true so i feel like they should hit the books and do more research to be honest.

if you never stop learning about what you mastered already you'll grow, there is never a time where you are not learning. We learn from our mistakes, the choices we made, to the friends we have. we learn how to make our family happy or what makes them sad, to learn what is bad for us and whats good for us. We learn everday and we never stop.
